panels.description: Red when an expected host hasn't completed a backup in 26 hours. Add a host to the query's list when it starts backing up.

targets.expr:
(
  (
    label_set(vector(1), "host", "lotus-land-story")
    or label_set(vector(1), "host", "imperishable-night")
  )
  unless on (host)
  (time() - max by (host) (last_over_time(backup_completed_timestamp{job="backup"}[2d])) < 26 * 3600)
)
or on () label_set(vector(0), "host", "all")

panels.description: Red when a host spent more than 10% of the last 5 minutes stalled on memory (PSI). The Pis report no data until they boot with psi=1.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
  (max by (instance) (rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total[5m])) > 0.1)
  or (max by (instance) (up{job="node-exporter"}) unless on (instance) node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total) * 0 - 1
  or on () label_set(vector(0), "instance", "all"),
  "instance", "$1", "instance", "(.*):\\d+"
)

panels.title: memory pressure

panels.description: Red when one of our sites or exporters is down. Third-party probes and the Prusa, which is usually off, are left out.

targets.expr:
(
  max by (name) (label_copy((1 - up{job=~"blackbox-exporter-http(-internal)?", instance!~"https://(www\\.)?(google|facebook|youtube|linuxserver)\\..*"}) > 0, "instance", "name"))
  or max by (name) (label_copy((1 - probe_success{job=~"blackbox-exporter-http(-internal)?", instance!~"https://(www\\.)?(google|facebook|youtube|linuxserver)\\..*"}) > 0, "instance", "name"))
  or max by (name) (label_copy((1 - up{job!~"blackbox-exporter.*|prusalink|prusaudp"}) > 0, "job", "name"))
  or on () label_set(absent(up), "name", "no scrape data")
)
or on () label_set(vector(0), "name", "all")

panels.title: reachability

panels.description: Pending security updates on Debian, or a needed reboot. On NixOS, the deployed nixpkgs being more than 7 days behind its branch head stands in for missing security fixes.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
  (
    max by (instance) (apt_upgrades_pending{origin=~"(?i).*security.*"}) > 0
    or (max by (instance) (nixpkgs_branch_lag_seconds) > 7 * 86400) * 0 - 2
    or (max by (instance) (node_reboot_required) > 0) * 0 - 1
    or (max by (instance) (up{job="node-exporter"}) unless on (instance) node_reboot_required) * 0 - 3
  )
  or on () label_set(vector(0), "instance", "all"),
  "instance", "$1", "instance", "(.*):\\d+"
)

panels.title: security updates

panels.description: Pending non-security updates: apt packages on Debian, nixpkgs commits behind on NixOS. Red only when a host reports no update data.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
  (
    sum by (instance) (apt_upgrades_pending{origin!~"(?i).*security.*"}) > 0
    or max by (instance) (nixpkgs_branch_commits_behind) > 0
    or (max by (instance) (up{job="node-exporter"}) unless on (instance) (apt_upgrades_pending or nixpkgs_branch_commits_behind)) * 0 - 1
  )
  or on () label_set(vector(0), "instance", "all"),
  "instance", "$1", "instance", "(.*):\\d+"
)
